# HMS 故障码 / HMS codes · 07

[返回索引 / Index](../../HMS-CODES.md) | [故障码说明 / Guide](../../ERROR-CODES.md)

同码可能因机型不同而有不同文案。来源和原始变体见 `docs/data/error-codes.json`。 Model-specific descriptions and source variants are preserved in that data file.

| 屏幕错误码 / Code | 中文说明 / Chinese | English description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0002` | AMS D 槽位2为空，请插入耗材。 | AMS D Slot 2 is empty; please insert a new filament. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0003` | AMS D 槽位2耗材可能断在AMS中。 | AMS D Slot 2's filament may be broken in AMS. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0004` | AMS D 槽位2耗材可能断在工具头。 | AMS D Slot 2 filament may be broken in the tool head. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0005` | AMS D 槽位2耗材用完，冲刷旧料异常，请检查耗材是否卡在工具头。 | AMS D Slot 2 filament has run out, and purging the old filament went abnormally; please check whether the filament is stuck in the tool head. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0006` | AMS D 进料过程中检测到特氟龙管断开，请检查AMS内部和外部的特氟龙管是否脱落、破损。 | AMS D has detected a breakage of the PTFE tube during filament loading. Please check whether the PTFE tubes inside and outside the AMS have fallen off or been damaged. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0007` | AMS D 槽位2出料霍尔传感器掉线，可能是连接线接触不良。 | AMS D Slot 2 feed-out Hall sensor is disconnected. The connector may have poor contact. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0008` | AMS D 槽位2进料霍尔传感器掉线,可能是插头接触不良。 | AMS D Slot 2 feed-in Hall sensor is disconnected, which may be due to poor connector contact. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0009` | AMS D槽位2耗材挤出异常，可能堵头或耗材过细导致挤出机打滑。 | Failed to extrude AMS D Slot 2 filament; the extruder may be clogged or the filament may be too thin, causing the extruder to slip. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-000A` | 缓冲器位置调节失败，AMS D 槽 2 耗材或者缓冲器可能卡住。 | Failed to adjust the buffer position. The AMS D Slot 2 filament or the buffer itself may be jammed. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0010` | AMS D 槽 2 耗材送出AMS超时。 | AMS D slot 2 feeds filament out of AMS timeout. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0011` | AMS D 槽 2 耗材退回AMS超时。 | AMS D slot 2 pulls filament back to AMS timeout. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0012` | AMS D 槽 2 上下料电机过载，无法转动料盘。 | AMS D slot 2 feeder unit motor is stalled, cannot rotate the spool. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0013` | AMS D 槽 2 上下料电机无信号，可能是电机插头接触不良或者电机故障。 | AMS D slot 2 feeder unit motor has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the motor connector or a motor fault. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0014` | AMS D 槽 2 里程轮无信号，可能是里程轮插头接触不良或故障。 | AMS D slot 2 filament odometer has no signal, which may be due to poor contact in the odometer connector or a odometer fault. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0015` | AMS D 槽 2 耗材状态异常，可能是AMS中有断料。 | AMS D slot 2 filament status is abnormal, which may be due to a filament breakage inside the AMS. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0016` | AMS D 槽 2 助力电机打滑，请拉出耗材剪掉磨损的部分然后重试。 | AMS D slot 2 assist motor has slipped. Please pull out the filament, cut off the worn part, and then try again. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0017` | AMS D 槽 2 助力电机过载，AMS至打印机之间料管阻力过大。 | AMS D slot 2 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the printer. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0018` | AMS D 槽 2 助力电机过载，AMS附近料管阻力过大。 | AMS D slot 2 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near AMS. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0019` | AMS D 槽 2 助力电机过载，AMS至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。 | AMS D slot 2 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between AMS and the filament buffer. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0020` | AMS D 槽 2 助力电机过载，缓冲器附近料管阻力过大。 | AMS D slot 2 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near the filament buffer. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0021` | AMS D 槽 2 助力电机过载，缓冲器至工具头之间料管阻力过大。 | AMS D slot 2 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube between the filament buffer and the toolhead. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0022` | AMS D 槽 2 助力电机过载，工具头附近料管阻力过大。 | AMS D slot 2 assist motor is stalled, due to excessive resistance in the tube near the toolhead. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0023` | AMS D 槽 2 AMS内部料管脱落，或者出料霍尔传感器异常，检测不到耗材。 | AMS D slot 2 the tube inside the AMS is broken, or feed-out hall sensor is faulty and cannot detect the filament. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0024` | AMS D 槽 2 耗材退回AMS时转动料盘失败。 | AMS D slot 2 failed to rotate the filament spool when pulling filament back to AMS. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0025` | AMS D 槽 2 进料阻力过大。请检查并减小料盘转动阻力，确保料管长度适中且无过度弯曲。 | AMS D slot 2 feed resistance is too high. Please reduce spool rotation resistance and avoid over-bent or over-long filament tubes. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0026` | AMS D 2 槽助力电机过载，AMS至耗材变轨器之间料管阻力过大。 | AMS D slot 2 assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the AMS and the filament track switch. |
| `HMS 0703-2100-0002-0027` | AMS D 2 槽助力电机过载，耗材变轨器至缓冲器之间料管阻力过大。 | AMS D slot 2 assist motor overloaded. Excessive resistance in the filament tube between the filament track switch and the filament buffer. |

| `HMS 0703-2100-0003-0002` | AMS D 槽位2耗材用完并已自动切换到有相同耗材的槽位。 | AMS D Slot 2 filament has run out and automatically switched to the slot with the same filament. |
| `HMS 0703-2200-0001-0081` | 读取AMS D槽位3的耗材信息失败，可能是AMS主板故障。 | Failed to read the filament information from AMS D slot 3. The AMS main board may be malfunctioning. |
| `HMS 0703-2200-0001-0082` | 读取AMS D槽位3的耗材信息失败，非官方标签，建议使用官方耗材。 | Failed to read the filament information from AMS D slot 3. A third party RFID tag was detected. |
